messages:
sam: Quick ask — can we get a concise one-pager (and a short launch post) that compares Private FastPath vs Dedicated Reserve for enterprise buyers? Focus: security posture, SLA tiers, typical latency/cost tradeoffs, and decision checklist for field/webinar followups. Need this for next week's webinar deck.

aline: +1. Do you want it framed as a side-by-side cheat sheet or a narrative with recommended use cases?

sam: Side-by-side for sales + an alternate single-slide narrative for webinar. Sales likes one-pagers they can drop into emails. Webinar needs the story/benchmarks.

maria: I can draft the narrative. We should call out: VPC/private control plane, KMS/HSM options, compliance mapping (SOC2/ISO/GDPR), and fallback/failover behavior across regions.

jake: Field note: buyers ask for example SLAs — do we put exact numbers or ranges? e.g., 99.9% / 99.95% and p50/p95 latency buckets. Also show what Dedicated Reserve burst looks like.

chris_ops: For accuracy: Dedicated Reserve typical p95 for 8k tokens is ~160-220ms on A100-sim configs; Private FastPath (multi-tenant hosted w/ VPC) p95 ~220-350ms depending on prefix cache. SLA commit: Dedicated has 99.95 target, Private has 99.9 (enterprise package). Will confirm exact wording with legal.

maria: Perfect — can you paste the three benchmark rows we should use? I'll turn into a small table.

chris_ops: Sure — copy below (rough):

```
Config                  | p50 (8k tokens) | p95 (8k tokens) | typical cost delta
Dedicated Reserve (A100) | 80-100ms        | 160-220ms       | baseline
Private FastPath (VPC)   | 120-180ms       | 220-350ms       | ~1.2-1.6x baseline
Hosted API (shared)       | 150-260ms       | 300-600ms       | ~1.4-2.5x baseline
```

sam: Nice — include a short caveat: numbers vary by model family, sequence length, and burst patterns. Keep language sales-friendly: "typical" and "indicative." 

aline: For the one-pager layout idea: top-left: 30s summary, top-right: quick decision flow (security priority vs cost sensitivity), middle: side-by-side bullets (security, SLA, throughput, ops), bottom-left: benchmark table, bottom-right: field playbook (questions to ask + routing: AE -> solutions -> SE).

jake: Add a routing note: inbound leads citing "SLA >99.95" or "on-prem/private" should be routed to AE + Solutions (channel: #enterprise-engage). Webinars that convert to trials: route to dedicated sales path.

maria: I'll draft by EOD today. Sam, want me to include a short launch post (tweet + blog blurb) or just sales copy?

sam: Both. Short tweetable hook + 2-paragraph blog blurb + 3 email snippets (AE outreach, field briefing, webinar invite).

chris_ops: Also add a single-line note about deployment modes for regulated buyers: "On-prem option available for air-gapped deployments; expect longer lead time and separate contract."

deploy-bot: artifact built: marketing/onepagers/draft-deploy-brief-v1.pdf (staging) — link: https://drive.redwood/example (preview) :package:

aline: Great. Maria — after the draft, can you drop two variants of the one-pager: (A) security-first tone, (B) cost-first tone? Field asks for both.

maria: Yep. Will do A/B. EOD draft -> sync tomorrow 10am to finalize.

sam: Thanks team. For webinar slides we'll import the narrative as slide 3 and the table slide as slide 4. Jake, can you coordinate with webinar ops for demo cadence?

jake: On it. I'll lock demo flow and handoff points, and update #webinar-planning.

aline: I'll prepare the short launch post copy once Maria drops the final. :sparkles:

sam: Awesome. tagging reminder: legal review required for SLA claims — @chris_ops will ping legal.

chris_ops: Pinging legal now. Expect clean language edits tomorrow.

maria: Drafted and uploaded: https://drive.redwood/onepagers/private-vs-dedicated-v1 (comments open).

sam: Reviewing now. If no blockers, publish to staging and route to AE bundle by noon tomorrow. :thumbsup:
